title: The Class Reunion
teaser: Fifteen years after graduation, Kirill Dorokhov rented a country house for the class for the weekend. Their old teacher brought the letters everyone had written to themselves at the leavers' ball. Dorokhov read his, went pale and spoke to nobody until night, and towards morning he was found dead in the attic by a broken window. His letter is missing, and no taxi from town will come before nine.
locations: The living room with the fireplace
professions: Owner who let the house for the weekend

habits.label: Class badge
habits.habit: A "Class of 2011" badge on their chest
clues: The pin that came out of a "Class of 2011" badge lies on the attic floor by the broken window. The culprit wears a class badge.
An armchair in the living room has a hole from a badge pin with a torn thread sticking out. The culprit wears a class badge.

habits.label: Film camera
habits.habit: Snaps everything on an old point-and-shoot film camera
clues: At about three in the morning someone on the first floor saw a short yellow flash in the attic, like from an old point-and-shoot. The culprit shoots on a film camera.
An empty 36-exposure film canister lies in the gazebo by the barbecue. The culprit shoots on a film camera.

habits.label: Smells of mulled wine
habits.habit: Smells of mulled wine and cinnamon
clues: The attic windowsill has a sticky ring from a glass that smells of wine and cinnamon. The culprit smells of mulled wine.
A pan of mulled wine stands on the cold stove in the kitchen, and the ladle is lying on the floor. The culprit smells of mulled wine.

habits.label: Hums 2000s hits
habits.habit: Hums hits from the 2000s under their breath
clues: At five to three someone heard a person going up the stairs to the attic humming a song from the leavers' ball. The culprit hums 2000s hits.
A line from a 2000s song is written with a finger on the misted window of a car in the garage. The culprit hums 2000s hits.

habits.label: Doodled trainers
habits.habit: Wears canvas trainers covered in marker doodles
clues: The light varnished attic floor has a print of a canvas trainer with a black mark from a marker. The culprit wears doodled trainers.
In the woods beyond the fence there's a trainer print with a flat ribbed sole on the wet leaves. The culprit wears doodled trainers.

habits.label: Football scarf
habits.habit: A football club scarf round the neck
clues: Dorokhov was strangled in the attic with something knitted; his neck has fibres of two colours on it. The culprit wears a football scarf.
Woollen fringe in club colours lies under the car in the garage. The culprit wears a football scarf.

habits.label: Sooty fingers
habits.habit: Fingers black with soot from the fireplace
clues: The frame of the broken attic window has black sooty fingerprints. The culprit has soot on their fingers.
The light switch in the corridor by the kitchen has a black fingerprint in soot from the fireplace. The culprit has soot on their fingers.

habits.label: Smells of eucalyptus
habits.habit: Smells of eucalyptus from the sauna
clues: The dry, cold attic smells oddly of eucalyptus, like a sauna. The culprit smells of eucalyptus.
A blanket in the living room smells of eucalyptus oil. The culprit smells of eucalyptus.

habits.label: Pine needles in the hair
habits.habit: Pine needles caught in their hair
clues: There are a few fresh pine needles on the attic floor, and there isn't a single pine tree in the house. The culprit has pine needles in their hair.
The bench in the gazebo has needles from the very pine that grows by the fence. The culprit has pine needles in their hair.

habits.label: Woolly socks
habits.habit: Pads around the house in thick woolly socks
clues: Every step on the stairs to the attic creaks under a boot, but nobody heard footsteps, and there are wool fibres on the steps. The culprit walks around in woolly socks.
The living room rug has grey bobbles from thick socks. The culprit walks around in woolly socks.

habits.label: Initials tattoo
habits.habit: Someone else's initials tattooed on their wrist
clues: Dorokhov managed to scratch someone: under his nails there's skin with dark ink in it, like from a tattoo. The culprit has initials on their wrist.
On the old class photo in the living room, someone has two letters on their wrist blacked out with marker. The culprit has initials on their wrist.

habits.label: Ring mark
habits.habit: A pale band on their finger from a removed ring
clues: A gold wedding ring lies on the attic windowsill, but none of the married guests will say it's theirs. The culprit has a ring mark on their finger.
A velvet ring box was left on the bench in the sauna. The culprit has a ring mark on their finger.

habits.label: Cigarillos
clues: There's cherry-scented ash by the broken attic window, like from cigarillos. The culprit smokes cigarillos.
An empty cigarillo tin lies on the workbench in the garage. The culprit smokes cigarillos.

habits.label: Lost voice
clues: The owner of the house heard a hoarse whisper from the attic: "You ruined everything." The culprit has lost their voice.
On the kitchen table there's an empty mug from tea with honey and lemon, and throat lozenges beside it. The culprit has lost their voice.

habits.label: Black eye
clues: Dorokhov's right knuckles are split: before he died he punched someone in the face. The culprit has a black eye.
A bag of peas went missing from the freezer and was later found melting in the gazebo by the barbecue. The culprit has a black eye.

habits.label: Tin of mints
clues: A round white mint lies under the bed in the attic. The culprit carries a tin of mints.
The village postman was walking past the fence and heard someone in the woods rattling a tin in rhythm. The culprit carries a tin of mints.

medic: The glass by the bed in the attic has traces of a sleeping drug in cognac, the dose matched to Dorokhov's weight. The culprit knows about poisons.
Ampoules of the sedative the owner keeps for her sheepdog are missing from the kitchen first-aid kit. The culprit knows about poisons.
tools: The attic window was broken from inside, but first its catch was carefully removed with a screwdriver. The culprit is handy with tools.
The number plates were taken off Dorokhov's car in the garage, and the bolts laid neatly beside it. The culprit is handy with tools.
sched: Dorokhov always went up to the attic to smoke at three in the morning, and everyone who shared his dorm knew it. The culprit knows the schedule.
At half past two the owner walks round the yard with her dog, and after that nobody goes out until morning. The culprit knows the schedule.
french: "Pardonne-moi", French for "Forgive me", is written on the misted mirror in the sauna. The culprit knows French.
In the yearbook, next to Dorokhov's photo, someone has added in fresh ink "Menteur", French for "Liar". The culprit knows French.
strong: Dorokhov, who weighed nearly ninety kilos, was lifted onto the attic windowsill. The culprit is physically strong.
The oak chest of drawers in the attic, which two people can barely lift, was pushed against the door from the inside. The culprit is physically strong.
keys: The attic locks with a key, only the owner and Dorokhov had keys, yet the door was opened without force. The culprit had keys.
The garage doors are locked, but the car inside has been moved. The culprit had keys.
tech: The camera over the entrance was switched off through the app on a phone that had the Wi-Fi password saved. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The fuses in the kitchen box were tripped so that only the attic lost power while the rest of the house stayed lit. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
quiet: The stairs to the attic creak with every step, three people were asleep in the room below, and nobody heard a thing. The culprit moves silently.
The owner's dog sleeps lightly in the kitchen, but that night it didn't growl once. The culprit moves silently.
cash: Dorokhov's wallet is empty, though in the evening he pulled out a wad of cash in front of everyone to pay for the meat and drinks. The culprit had access to money.
At 03:10 a large transfer left Dorokhov's card, supposedly for the house rent, but not to the owner. The culprit had access to money.
driver: Dorokhov's car was driven out of the garage into the woods beyond the fence and back, and its bonnet is still warm. The culprit can drive.
There are fresh tyre tracks on the dirt road to the house, though nobody called a taxi. The culprit can drive.
safe: The safe in the owner's bedroom, where Dorokhov put the envelope with the money for the house, was opened with the code. The culprit knows the safe combination.
Dorokhov's laptop in the attic was unlocked with the password, not a fingerprint, and the photos from the leavers' ball were deleted from it. The culprit knows the safe combination.
passages: You can climb out of the attic onto the garage roof through a skylight. Only the owner knows about it, and anyone who read the rental listing carefully. The skylight is open. The culprit knows the service passages.
A door through the boiler room leads from the sauna to the garage. It isn't locked, and there are fresh footprints on the boiler room floor. The culprit knows the service passages.
